triggers.note: Illustrative zones and thresholds, not real policies. Tiers are anchored to IMD category boundaries (wind) and the 300 mm / 3-day trigger in CDRI's Odisha study (rain). Payouts are shares of sum insured; no monetary amounts are modelled.
triggers.material_loss_rule: at least 5 red assets in the zone
triggers.observed_rain_source: GPM IMERG observed rainfall, 48 h before to 24 h after landfall

ensemble.caveat: Real verification: a WeatherNext 3 ensemble issued 15 h before landfall, scored only on positions after it was issued, against IMD's post-analysis best track. One storm is an anecdote, not a statistic.

vs_imd.interpretation: At landfall time the WeatherNext 3 ensemble-mean position was 20 km from the observed centre, forecast 15 h out; individual members averaged 34 km. IMD reports landfall-point error averaged over five years of storms -- a related but different measure -- and this is one storm, so it shows the comparison can be made, not which forecaster is better.

sources.name: GPM IMERG
sources.measures: rainfall that fell, to score the rain forecast and set the trigger index

sources.name: VIIRS Black Marble
sources.measures: power outage extent, from the drop in night-time radiance

observations.note: Each check reports its own result or its own failure: a missing Sentinel-1 pass costs the flood check, not the rain check.

flood.rule: predicted: ensemble P(depth > 0.2 m) >= 0.5; observed: >= 5% of the cell newly flooded

outage.rule: predicted: substation P(failure) >= 0.3; observed: night-time radiance down >= 50% in its cell
